en-US.author: SoftPerfect Pty Ltd
en-US.description: Easy network switch port identification for Windows, macOS and Linux
en-US.longDescription:
The SoftPerfect Switch Port Mapper tool works with managed network switches and reports what is connected to switch ports, and which ports are not connected. For every connected port, the port mapper lists the MAC address, IP address and host names of the computers associated with that port.
Additionally, the software can display each client’s network card vendor, port speed, device type, VLAN assignments and statistics for every port. This can be of good assistance when troubleshooting network connectivity issues.
Key features
- Discovers managed switches by scanning your network.
- Shows what is connected to every switch port in a simple table format.
- Pulls ARP table from a router to display IP information of connected clients.
- Scans the current subnet for MAC-to-IP address mappings if there is no router.
- Comes in two editions: a GUI application and a console application for using in scripts.
- Fully supports SNMPv1, SNMPv2c and SNMPv3, including bulk operations.
en-US.name: SoftPerfect Switch Port Mapper
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Added: Status line with progress and Up/Down port filters.
- Improved: Faster subnet scanning that can be stopped at once.
- Improved: Faster scanning of switches without SNMP bulk support.
- Improved: Modernised user interface.
- Improved: Console help now lists the column names for /column.
- Changed: The Linux version now uses GTK3.
- Fixed: Speed column sorted incorrectly, and 2.5G ports were shown as 2G.
- Fixed: LLDP neighbours missing on Cisco ports outside VLAN 1.
- Fixed: No IP information from devices with only the newer ARP table.

zh-CN.description: 轻松识别网络交换机端口的工具，适用于 Windows、macOS 和 Linux
zh-CN.longDescription:
SoftPerfect 交换机端口映射工具可与可管理网络交换机配合使用，报告交换机端口的连接状态及空闲端口情况。对于每个已连接的端口，该工具会列出关联设备的 MAC 地址、IP 地址及主机名。
此外，软件还能显示每个客户端的网卡厂商、端口速率、设备类型、VLAN 分配及端口统计信息，这些功能在网络连通性故障排查中能提供有效帮助。
主要特性
- 通过扫描网络自动发现可管理交换机
- 以简洁表格形式展示每个交换机端口的连接设备
- 从路由器获取 ARP 表以显示已连接客户端的 IP 信息
- 若无路由器，则扫描当前子网的 MAC-IP 地址映射关系
- 提供图形界面（GUI）和命令行（控制台）两种版本，后者支持脚本调用
- 完整支持 SNMPv1/v2c/v3 协议（含批量操作功能）
